definitions.gloss: registered seal; official seal; legal seal
definitions.explanation: A personal seal that has been officially registered with the local government through a process called {印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}. Used for important legal and financial transactions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実印|じついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A registered seal is required for real estate contracts.

examples.japanese: {実印|じついん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to go to the government office to register your seal.

examples.japanese: {実印|じついん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{印鑑証明書|いんかんしょうめいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}して→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please bring your registered seal and seal certificate.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (real, actual) + {印|いん} (seal)

Literally "real seal" - the officially recognized seal.

REGISTRATION PROCESS:
To make a seal your {実印|じついん}, you must:
1. ⟦{印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}→印鑑登録：07491_inkantouroku⟧ - register it at your local ⟦{市区町村|しくちょうそん}→市区町村：23061_shikuchouson⟧ office
2. You'll receive an {印鑑登録証|いんかんとうろくしょう} (registration card)
3. You can then obtain {印鑑証明書|いんかんしょうめいしょ} (seal certificate) as needed

WHEN REQUIRED:
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧ - real estate transactions
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧/⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧ - buying/selling cars
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧ - company establishment
- ⟦{保証人|ほしょうにん}→保証人：19978_hoshounin⟧ - acting as guarantor
- ⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧ - inheritance matters

SEAL SPECIFICATIONS:
{実印|じついん} typically should be:
- Unique (not mass-produced)
- Larger than ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧ (usually 13.5-18mm)
- Made of durable material

WATCH OUT:
Never lend your {実印|じついん} to others - it can be used to enter into binding contracts in your name.
